series: 共同决定之后 / After the Shared Decision

browser_readable_court_text_mirror.verification: Full judicial opinion read using the web tool; source is explicitly identified as a text mirror, not the court's own host.

rhine: Commission cooperation predates the fire; 1963 agreement gave an existing commission an international legal basis.
1985–2000 reductions refer to point-source inputs of most priority pollutants; no blanket all-pollution statistic or isolated programme causation.
1999 convention is identified as signed later, not projected into 1986; Article 11 covers implementation, not Article 9.
National implementation, reporting and consultation are retained; NGO participation is not an individual damages court.
No unsupported conclusion that all affected persons obtained compensation or that every domestic remedy failed.
haiti: Introduction, spread, legal responsibility, jurisdiction and individual damages remain distinct.
2011 panel wording is attributed as a contemporary account, not a binding no-fault determination; later scientific evidence is dated.
2013 refusal is not an independent merits hearing; 2016 Georges dismissal for lack of subject-matter jurisdiction is not merits exoneration.
The court is not said to have found a Section 29 breach; the functional rationale of immunity is included.
2016 apology, proposed material assistance and an individual merits remedy are not equated.
Narrative stops in 2016; the 2017 official report is used only to confirm the 2016 apology and Assembly response.
historical_source_audit.comparative_boundary: Response to a company accident on the Rhine differs from an international operation itself implicated in Haiti's harm; the essays are not opposite success/failure grades.
